required_quantification: per-biological-replicate gene quantifications TSV, same assembly and annotation
model_training_rule: never use ENCODE CRISPRi perturbation responses as model features or priors
biological_claims: downstream perturbation-responsive expression, not proven direct TF binding
evaluation_rule: continuous perturbation-response association or validated response enrichment; do not call unresponsive genes proven negatives
exclusions: retain all 6 accessions in denominator; exclude file/method/assay if metadata fails; record explicit reasons; do not replace TFs after outcome inspection
